headers.subject: You’ve Been Selected: Quick Culture Survey (Gift Card Drawing)

body_text:
Hello,
You’ve been selected to participate in a short culture survey this week. Participation is optional, and responses are reviewed in aggregate.
Everyone who completes the survey by Friday will be entered into a random drawing for a gift card.
Thanks,
Communications
Survey can be found here: https://nebulon-surveys[.]com/claim?token=Q2X17K4
